# KeyProcess Automation Services

> KeyProcess Automation Services builds and manages business process automation for small and mid-sized businesses in any industry across the United States. We automate the repetitive work in sales, operations, bookkeeping, marketing, and reporting, including AI automation where it saves real time, so teams get hours back every week.

- Who we help: owners and managers of businesses with 3 people or 300, including property management, e-commerce, home services, professional offices, healthcare practices, agencies, retail, and nonprofits.
- Pricing: a single automated process from $1,000; a workflow package of 3 to 5 connected automations from $3,000; Automation Care (monitoring, fixes, and monthly improvements) from $500 a month.
- Guarantee: if an automation doesn't save your team time in the first 30 days, we fix it free until it does.
- Every project starts with a free 30-minute automation audit and a fixed quote.
- Contact: tyler@keyprocessautomation.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/keyprocess-automation-services

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.keyprocessautomation.com/): services, savings calculator, pricing, guarantee, and FAQ
- [AI Workforce](https://www.keyprocessautomation.com/ai-workforce): a done-for-you team of AI employees for any department (sales, customer service, operations, finance, HR, marketing, and leadership). Each AI employee has a desk, a job description, a task list, connections to the business's tools, and a scorecard showing cost and return, and nothing customer-facing goes out without an owner's approval. Three packages (Pilot Desk, Department Team, Full Office), each with a one-time setup fee and a monthly plan.
- [Case studies](https://www.keyprocessautomation.com/results): real automations and the time they save
- [Live automation demo](https://www.keyprocessautomation.com/automation-hub): pick a task, press Run, and watch each automated step happen
- [Free automation audit](https://www.keyprocessautomation.com/audit): request an audit
- [Small business automation questions, answered](https://www.keyprocessautomation.com/small-business-automation): 24 plain-English answers on what automation is, what to automate (data entry, invoices, reports, follow-ups, onboarding, customer service), cost, time saved, and getting help

## Services

- [AI automation](https://www.keyprocessautomation.com/ai-automation): AI built into everyday workflows to draft captions, product copy, articles, and replies, and to pull details out of messy emails and documents, with your team approving what matters
- [E-commerce automation](https://www.keyprocessautomation.com/ecommerce-automation): promotions, order tracking, and product reviews for online stores
- [Home services automation](https://www.keyprocessautomation.com/home-services-automation): quote follow-ups, reminders, review requests, and invoice reminders for contractors
- [Leasing automation](https://www.keyprocessautomation.com/leasing-automation): approval letters, leases, and daily reports for property managers
- [Maintenance automation](https://www.keyprocessautomation.com/maintenance-automation): work order follow-ups and maintenance reports
- [Bookkeeping automation](https://www.keyprocessautomation.com/bookkeeping-automation): bills matched and logged, with exceptions flagged
- [Marketing automation](https://www.keyprocessautomation.com/marketing-automation): listings and social posts kept current everywhere

## Quick answers

- What does KeyProcess Automation Services do? It builds and manages automations that take repetitive work off small and mid-sized teams, such as paperwork, follow-ups, bookkeeping, marketing, and reporting, using the software a business already has.
- Does KeyProcess Automation Services do AI automation? Yes. It adds AI where a step needs reading or writing, such as drafting captions, product descriptions, articles, and replies, or pulling names, dates, and amounts out of unstructured text. Steps that must be exact stay rules-based, and a person approves anything customer-facing or financial.
- What is AI automation? Automation that uses artificial intelligence for the steps that need language, while rules handle the steps that must be exact.
- Who is it for? Businesses of 3 people or 300 in any industry, anywhere in the United States. Work is done remotely.
- How much does it cost? From $1,000 for one automated process, from $3,000 for 3 to 5 connected automations, and from $500 a month for Automation Care. Every project starts with a free 30-minute audit and a fixed quote.
- What is the AI Workforce? A team of AI employees, each with one job, a desk, a written job description, and a scorecard, built for any department. Work is approved by named people before it goes out, ad spend is owner-only, and people decisions stay human. In its first five days with a DTC beverage brand's marketing team, it produced 163 finished deliverables (up from 13 in the five days before) and completed 122 of 141 tasks while the owners made 21 decisions, on one $100-a-month subscription. November sales rose 84% year over year alongside the team, in peak gift season, which is a correlation rather than proof of cause.
- What results has it delivered? Lease approval packets cut from 2 hours to 10 minutes, 100 to 250 follow-ups sent every Monday hands-free, and one video posted to 5 platforms with captions written for each. See the case studies.
